description: React component for the settings sidebar in Mattermost, managing tab display, navigation, and interaction.

classes.name: SettingsSidebar
classes.description: React component for rendering and managing the settings sidebar with tabs, including keyboard navigation and dynamic tab rendering.

methods.name: getVisibleTabs
methods.description: Returns all tabs (regular and plugin) that are set to display.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on tabs, updating the active tab and displaying content.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation (up/down arrows) between tabs.

methods.name: renderTab
methods.description: Renders individual tab buttons with icons and labels.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire sidebar with tabs and plugin preferences section.
